name: Podia
summary: Platform for courses, downloads and memberships.

flows.title: Create an online course
steps: From your home feed, click your site name and select Admin from the dropdown menu.
From the Admin dashboard, click Products in the sidebar menu.
From the Products page, click + New Product.
On the product creation page, select Course and give the product a name.

flows.title: Add lessons and sections to a course, then publish it
steps: After creating the course, the next step is to add your content — you need at least one lesson before you can publish it.
Click + New lesson and choose what to add: Lesson, Quiz or Files.
To group related lessons together, click the + New section button.
To move a lesson or a whole section, click the three-line icon next to it and drag it where you want it.
When the course is set up, click Publish at the top right.
